submittedParameters.prompt:
Production atlas of modular ISOMETRIC WATER AND SHORE TILES for the same refined Taoist chibi transport world as references. Genuine transparent background, no text/labels/UI. 3x3 grid, nine complete identical horizontal 2:1 diamonds, flat top surfaces with NO vertical extrusion/outline, orthographic isometric view, gentle watercolor hand-painted jade/teal water, pale warm stone/sand and natural sage grass. 20% transparent separation between cells; high native resolution, desired2048 square.
Rows1 and2: 6 near-identical flat deep jade-blue WATER DIAMONDS with extremely subtle small cream/celadon ripple highlights, sequential loop phases 1,2,3,4,5,6 of ONE calm gentle surface. No moving shore or large wave, opposite edges same water color, surface fills rhombus to every edge. All phases same value, not six different water colors.
Row3: three additional material diamonds: shallow jade water with visible pale sand under it; thin pale-sand/coastal ground (no rocks, useful shoreline terrain fill); smooth natural light gray riverbed pebbles.
No boats, fish, lotus, structures, trees, animals, objects, characters, labels, shadows outside rhombi. Keep texture subdued and repeatable at borders. Every diamond same exact size and orientation, transparent outside only.
